_meta.title: Glossary
_meta.note: Definitions follow the official NBA.com stats glossary. Where a term has a project-specific meaning, that meaning is stated separately.

terms.project_use: Used to project a game's possession count as pace_home + pace_away - league_pace.
The denominator for ratings; verified against pace x minutes / 48 in verify_data.py.

terms.official_definition: Offensive Rating: points scored per 100 possessions.
terms.project_use: Multiplied by the opponent's DefRtg and divided by the league average to project points.

terms.official_definition: Defensive Rating: points allowed per 100 possessions.
terms.project_use: Same as above, in the opponent's direction.

terms.official_definition: Net Rating: 100 x (points - points allowed) / possessions.
terms.project_use: Identical to OffRtg - DefRtg. Treated as structural, not a signal.

terms.official_definition: True Shooting Percentage: a measure of shooting efficiency that accounts for two- and three-point field goals and free throws.
terms.project_use: Correlated against OffRtg as a descriptive check.

terms.official_definition: Effective Field Goal Percentage: adjusts a field-goal percentage so that a three-point field goal is worth one and a half field goals.
Offensive Rebound Percentage: the share of available offensive rebounds a team grabs.
Assist Percentage: the share of a team's field goals that are assisted while a player is on the floor.
terms.project_use: Tested against pace; no relationship found (r=0.062).
A line this project computes itself from official inputs. Never a sportsbook price.
A prop line set at .5 so that no push is possible.
A player who last appeared on 11/10 or later, so his absence is not yet inside his team's season stats.
A player whose absence is already reflected in team form because he missed several prior games.
Using information that was not available before the event being predicted, e.g. season stats that include the game itself.
